emotion: Luxury, Authority, Clean, Premium, Technologically Advanced

colors.strategy: Archetype 5 (Luxury) mixed with Archetype 4 (High-Contrast). The palette is defined by runtime CSS variables (--sh-*) from the DB. Do not hardcode hex colors that overwrite these.
colors.primary: var(--sh-ink) for deepest darks, var(--sh-gold) for premium accents.
colors.backgrounds: var(--sh-bg) for Ivory/White base, var(--sh-surface) for cards and isolated elements.
colors.text: var(--sh-text) for body copy. Ensure high contrast against var(--sh-bg) and var(--sh-surface).
rules: DO NOT use raw hex codes for primary UI colors. Always use standard tailwind classes mapped to these variables (e.g., bg-sh-bg, text-sh-text, text-sh-gold) assuming tailwind is configured for them, or use style={{ color: 'var(--sh-gold)' }} if strictly dynamic.
Use gold accents sparingly. It must feel like an accent (buttons, icons, gradients), not a dominant background.
Never use pure black or pure white if the variables provide tinted versions.

typography.strategy: Oversized, editorial typography for headlines. High legibility for data and secondary text.

fonts.display: var(--sh-font_display) (Currently Sora) - Use for H1, H2, H3, large numbers.
fonts.body: var(--sh-font_body) (Currently Manrope) - Use for body text, descriptions, labels, and microcopy.

rules: Fix small text: Minimum font size for secondary info should be text-sm, never smaller unless strictly decorative.
Ensure hierarchy: Prices should be prominent (e.g., text-2xl font-display text-sh-ink), while labels (sqm, rooms) use body font in text-sm.

layouts.strategy: Mobile-first, asymmetrical, generous whitespace, cinematic feel.
layouts.spacing: Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for breathing room. Avoid cramped layouts.
layouts.hero: Single-purpose, high impact. Large cinematic image/video, bold typography, clear CTA. Not a cluttered list of blocks.
layouts.catalog_grids: Use 1-col on mobile, 2-col on tablet, 3-col on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8).
layouts.bento_grids: For Home sections and Admin (Cabina di Regia), use bento layouts to avoid monotonous lists.
layouts.navigation: Sticky top navbar (glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-sh-bg/80 border-b border-sh-ink/10). Bottom-nav for mobile. Fixed elements must not cover content (add proper padding to main container).

property_card.container: Rounded to var(--sh-radius), bg-sh-surface, overflow-hidden, subtle shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 .hover-lift
property_card.image: aspect-[4/3] object-cover w-full, absolutely no distortion. Ensure high-quality rendering.
property_card.badges: Absolute positioned over image. Use .chip or .pill-dark for 'Sale', 'Rent', 'Auction'. var(--sh-amber) for auctions, var(--sh-emerald) for verified.
property_card.title_location: H4 font-display text-sh-ink truncate, accompanied by text-sm text-sh-text/70 for location.
property_card.features: Flex row, gap-4, text-sm. Use consistent icons (lucide-react) for beds, baths, sqm.
property_card.price_action: Flex justify-between items-center mt-2. Price in H3. Action button (.metallic or .btn-dark).

buttons.primary: .metallic (gold accent) or .btn-dark (ink accent) with distinct hover states. Must have clear contrast.
buttons.states: Add hover, focus, active, and disabled states. Add slight scale-down on active (active:scale-95).

forms_and_filters.inputs: bg-transparent border border-sh-ink/20 rounded-[var(--sh-radius)] focus:border-sh-gold focus:ring-1 focus:ring-sh-gold transition-all.

admin_dashboard.layout: Dense but clean. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.

visual_enhancers.borders_shadows: Moderate. Use 1px subtle borders (border-sh-ink/10). Shadows should be soft, ambient (shadow-sm, hover:shadow-lg).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: .glass and .glass-gold for sticky navs, floating action bars, and overlays. Ensure 1px inner border for optical clarity.
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer motion for page transitions, stagger effects on lists (catalog), subtle hover-lifts on cards.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for elegance.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Loading states (skeletons), empty states (well-designed with illustration/icon and CTA), clear error messages with var(--sh-amber).

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to text contrast against backgrounds. Avoid text-sh-text/50 if unreadable, use /70 minimum.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for mobile buttons and icons (bottom-nav).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='property-card-1', data-testid='contact-submit-btn').

hero_exterior.description: Luxury modern villa with pool, suitable for Hero section.

interior_apartment.description: Elegant modern living room for interior detail view.

agent_portrait.description: Premium real estate agent portrait for 'Chi Cerca' or contact sections.

premium_exterior_2.description: Stunning modern villa with cars, good for catalog premium listing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Implement glass-morphism effects using backdrop-blur (12-24px) for sticky headers and overlays.
Avoid using emoji characters like 🤖 or 🏠 for icons; use lucide-react exclusively.
Ensure generous spacing (p-6 to p-12) to maintain the premium feel.
Use layered z-index hierarchy to create depth, especially for sticky CTA bars (property detail) and floating navs.
Map all UI colors to the provided CSS variables (--sh-bg, --sh-surface, --sh-ink, --sh-gold). The app will inject these dynamically.
Ensure 'mobile-first' responsiveness. Images shouldn't stretch or compress awkwardly.
Keep typography scales consistent; no tiny, unreadable labels.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and micro-interactions.
Add data-testid to every interactive component.
